rules.title: Review native Java deserialization
rules.guidance: Verify trust boundary; prefer constrained schema-based serialization.

rules.title: Review ThreadLocal lifecycle
rules.guidance: Check cleanup in finally, especially with pooled threads.

rules.title: Review scheduled job multi-instance behavior
rules.guidance: Check overlap, replicas, idempotency, coordination and shutdown.

rules.title: Review asynchronous executor bounds
rules.guidance: Check bounded queues, rejection, exceptions and executor lifecycle.

rules.title: Review retry safety
rules.guidance: Check retry limits, backoff, jitter, idempotency and retry storms.

rules.title: Review process execution
rules.guidance: Validate input, avoid shell interpolation and constrain permissions.

rules.title: Review stack trace printing
rules.guidance: Use structured logging and avoid sensitive data.
